headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others saw modest or declining performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra also delivered double‑digit top‑line growth, supported by AI‑related deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% YoY growth, while Wipro's profit fell 1.9% despite 9.1% revenue growth. Overall, AI services were a key driver, but margin pressure and guidance cuts tempered sentiment.
